QuestInfo.name: Approach
QuestInfo.0: Someone is suddenly talking to you. Is this person...a Cygnus Knight?
QuestInfo.1: 10 Boogies of the Cygnus Knights heard of your recent feats and wanted to talk to you. But this was merely their trap!
QuestInfo.2: Surprisingly, the Cygnus Knights had the same enemy as the Nova, none other than Magnus himself. Magnus already crossed into Maple World and began wreaking havoc. This was the perfect opportunity for Cygnus Knights to form an alliance...
